notes: expect: every item must be selected; an item that is a list means any one of those names satisfies it.
allow: optional companions that do not count as stray loads (correct multi-skill composition).
forbid: must not be selected. Any selection outside expect+allow is a stray load and fails the case.
Cases describe user intent; expectations are what a careful router should do regardless of how a description is worded.
